title: Prove the exact signed connector tariff over every coefficient ring
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact signed 3x3 dirty-connector tariff over every nonzero unital coefficient ring. For the canonical PR944 target, with six positive complete-call prices equal between signs and sum S:

```text
characteristic 2          -> 2S                     -> 12 unit calls
characteristic 3          -> 2S + min(price)        -> 13 unit calls
characteristic 0 or >= 4  -> 2S + 2 min(price)      -> 14 unit calls
```

Claim type: scoped proof with a finite certificate. The new result transfers the characteristic-zero obstruction to all characteristics at least four, including composite characteristics and zero divisors, and lifts the F3 construction to all characteristic-three rings. This settles the released characteristic handoff. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change.

Ross Richardson's #944 obstruction, martinxxx9's #1088 six weighted repairs and Sagar Thakrar's #1349 F3 construction are explicitly credited dependencies. Their earlier results are not the deliverable. Only `research/signed-characteristic-spectrum/` is added, at publication head `d56d43c726dddc37a97a5dabf9d13ef861394133`, scientific base `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7.

## Evidence

Before: the retained signed minimum and price envelope were scoped to characteristic zero, with a separate F3 result. After: a written prime-subring/no-alias argument proves the complete characteristic spectrum for uniform arbitrary linear maps and dirty data. Three signed occurrences cannot restore outside characteristic three, while the paired-path coefficient differences cannot alias in characteristic at least three.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 passes both normal and optimized scientific checks. Each prints `PASS_SIGNED_CHARACTERISTIC_SPECTRUM` with 238 signed-count cases, 10,935 no-alias cases, 24 rational price cases, 13 literal witnesses, 2,190 noncommuting dual-ring dense cases and 199 rejection controls. Every dense case checks forward action, inverse action and dirty round trip. The registered checks took 0.339 and 0.334 seconds locally, below their 60-second limits. These are check durations, not a performance comparison.

The package runner and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` pass, authenticating all ten package/input files and source history. Official committed export integrity passes. Normal and optimized Git-free replays pass on the read-only export; all eleven exported files remain unchanged. Deliberately altered source and receipt bytes are rejected. The receipt is generated and bound to package/input hashes.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/signed-characteristic-spectrum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/signed-characteristic-spectrum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/signed-characteristic-spectrum
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/signed-characteristic-spectrum --check-source-history
```

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal result is a written scoped proof using PR944's credited paired-path obstruction. Finite modular execution does not enumerate every ring. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No selected cold replay, physical supplier ports, complete implementation prices, all-size compiler/stock, precision/tape or outer multiplication theorem is supplied. Sign-dependent call prices and extra operations are outside scope.

## Open next questions

1. Determine the exact envelope with different prices for the two signs. Start with signed count-vector lower bounds and the six repairs; other restoring words may become optimal.
2. Locate a source-bound supplier caller with the exact signed 3x3 demand and price every port, frame change, restoration and precision obligation before claiming downstream savings.

## Related open work

- #4231 classifies the unsigned five-source connector over coefficient rings. It has different demand and permitted signs. No identical target or numerical quantity is shared; its 36c formula is not applied to this signed target.
- #4225 proves the unsigned F3 five-source 108-call optimum. This signed three-source theorem uses #1349 instead; no overlapping call count is asserted or rerun.
- #4226 (closed as a duplicate of merged #2063, `research/connector-all-tariff-optimum`, which proves the same envelope) gives the unequal-price binary five-source envelope. It concerns a different target and coefficient characteristic; no identical numerical quantity is shared.
- #4189 gives the unsigned F3 one-source six-call optimum. It is a separate smaller interface, with no shared target or numerical count here.

The actually overlapping predecessor values are checked directly in the pinned words: #1088's six integer repairs each have 14 calls, and #1349's six F3 repairs each have 13. Their characteristic-zero and F3 minima retain predecessor credit.

## CI notes

Local metadata, both registered scientific commands, committed-byte/source-history and committed-export checks pass. Hosted CI is green on publication head `d56d43c726dddc37a97a5dabf9d13ef861394133`: [run 39488241315](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39488241315), `plan` passed in 2m45s and package `replay` passed in 1m18s. The hosted log confirms both scientific PASS markers with the local counts, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and the unchanged-input check. No check failed.

## Merge danger

Reversible isolated research package. The affected scope is this package and its explicit replay manifest; production sources and the selected record are unchanged.
